name: @automagik/locale-pt-br-dsh
description: Brazilian Portuguese for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2 and later: the Bot team's Portuguese (omni-ui) and the DSH strings DSH's own pt gets wrong (date order, number grouping, plan hint, mistranslations), under a pt-BR entry that falls back to DSH's pt. Correctness over a single picker entry until DSH fixes its copy

description.en: Brazilian Portuguese for DSH 0.2.2 and later. DSH ships Portuguese itself; this pack adds the Bot team's Portuguese, and keeps a pt-BR entry for the DSH strings DSH's copy gets wrong: date order (Nov 6 shown as 11/6), the thousands separator, the English plan hint, and several mistranslations. It falls back to DSH's Portuguese for everything else. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2 or later.
